NRG (formerly stylized as NRG Esports and NRG eSports) is an American esports organization, formed after co-owners of the NBA's Sacramento Kings entered the League of Legends LCS. Initially competing in Counter-Strike: Global Offensive from January 2016 to September 2019, NRG re-entered the professional scene after four years in November 2023.
